facts: A new part-of-speech tagger is presented.
The part-of-speech tagger demonstrates explicit use of both preceding and following tag contexts.
The part-of-speech tagger uses a dependency network representation.
The part-of-speech tagger makes broad use of lexical features.
The part-of-speech tagger jointly conditions on multiple consecutive words.
The part-of-speech tagger makes effective use of priors in conditional loglinear models.
The part-of-speech tagger models unknown word features in a fine-grained way.
The resulting tagger gives a 97.24 % accuracy.
The 97.24 % accuracy is on the Penn Treebank WSJ.
The tagger achieves an error reduction of 4.4 %.
The error reduction is measured on the best previous single automatically learned tagging result.
The part-of-speech tagger explicitly uses preceding tag contexts.
The part-of-speech tagger explicitly uses following tag contexts.
The part-of-speech tagger demonstrates the following ideas.
entities: fine-grained modeling of unknown word features
